items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 13:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the two kinds of influx? There are two statures for Aba and Ima of Atzilut. One is their permanent stature, which is the stature of SAG, who clothe the HGT of AA, and they have no share in its GAR, which is the stature of AB, and then they bestow the aspect of the GAR of Bina, which are covered Hassadim, and this influx is necessary for the existence of the worlds and their establishment, and therefore from this aspect their coupling never ceases. And the second is the stature of AB, which Aba and Ima attain through their ascent to the GAR of AA, and take its stature of AB, namely the stature of AB that comes out upon the MAN of the hairs. And this influx is for the Mochin of birth, called blessing and freedom, and in these are divided the main influxes in the worlds: the first, the influx of existence and establishment; and the second, the influx of blessing and freedom, which are the Mochin of birth. And see below, Answer 19, that even in the Mochin of birth themselves these two kinds of influx operate. (Items 52 and 55).
